note: Three answers to the recent-chat request (cmd 15101), one per line, each from another live (danmakuKeys in the same order), recorded 2026-09-28 22:00-22:01 UTC. Picked from 26 answers because they hold what S09 and S10 lack: donations (messageTypeCode 10: CHAT and VIDEO, anonymous and named), a subscription (11) and lines hidden by the clean bot (CBOTBLIND). `t` is the time since the first answer. User ids, nicknames (also in extras and weeklyRankList), tokens and donation ids are synthetic values of the same shape and length; the streamers' public channel ids and names, chat text and amounts are kept. The handshake headers are what the recorder gave dart:io, which sends the user-agent after its own ("Dart/3.13 (dart:io), Mozilla/5.0 …"); the server accepts it.
